description: Returns the limit swaps queue containing pending limit orders. Each entry includes swap details, ratio, age, and expiry information. Supports filtering by source/target asset, sender, and pagination. Limit orders only work when AdvSwapQueueEnabled is true.

limit.description: Number of items to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

sort_by.description: Sort field: ratio, age, amount, or created_height (default: ratio)

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc or desc (default: asc)

name: get_limit_swaps
